scope: Injected credential reader and fetch only; no real helper, GitHub requests, model calls or external writes
checks: RC04-T01: explicit authorization and fixed repository are checked before credential or network access
RC04-T02: helper and invalid-token failures expose fixed codes and perform no network access
RC04-T03: discover verifies the user and selects at most three open unmerged independently authored PRs
RC04-T04: exact selected detail scope is frozen and list arbitrary queries aliases URLs and writes are rejected before I/O
RC04-T05: safe observations retain actual response hashes and sequence without manufacturing HEAD changes
RC04-T06: redirect and foreign response URL are rejected without exposing response bodies
RC04-T07: one MiB header and streamed-body bounds reject oversized responses
RC04-T08: official authentication failures clear credentials and fence later network requests
RC04-T09: malformed identity discovery and detail facts fail with fixed safe errors
RC04-T10: empty independent open selection and out-of-range discovery limits are explicit
RC04-T11: transport errors and secret-bearing response fields never enter public evidence or environment
RC04-T12: close aborts an active request clears credential and rejects future I/O
